name: Vale
greeting: I want a future with you in it. Not written for me. Not promised somewhere else as well.
lines: Vale: Our own words. And the right to speak again if the words stop being true.

actions.label: I choose you, freely and exclusively.

relationship_event.text: Vale and Kael explicitly chose a mutual, exclusive adult relationship. Her work remains her own.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I am glad to see you. That is my whole reason this time.

actions.label: I can promise honest friendship, but not a shared life.

relationship_event.text: Kael declined romantic commitment to Vale without withdrawing friendship.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: No debt for the answer. Come back when you want company.
